evidence: The mixed-phase (1T and 2H) MoS2 layers were characterized using XPS, XRD, TEM, SEM, and Raman spectroscopy. The study also mentions the use of AFM, ellipsometry, XRR, Mott-Schottky analysis, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), cyclic voltammetry, and linear sweep voltamperometry for the analysis of the ALD process and the resulting films.
